description: Source code for Warehouse doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for warehouse management, and utility functions.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Represents a warehouse entity with methods for managing warehouse data, hierarchy, and conversions.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates the name of the warehouse, appending company abbreviation if applicable.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads account info and contact details when warehouse document is loaded.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Updates the nested set model after modifications.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles deletion of warehouse, including checks for stock quantities and child warehouses.

methods.name: check_if_sle_exists
methods.description: Checks if stock ledger entries exist for the warehouse.

methods.name: convert_to_group_or_ledger
methods.description: Converts warehouse to group or ledger type.

methods.name: convert_to_ledger
methods.description: Converts warehouse to ledger type if no child or transactions exist.

methods.name: convert_to_group
methods.description: Converts warehouse to group type if no stock transactions exist.
